status: EVIDENCE INDEX COMPLETE FOR SIX OPERATIONAL IDENTITIES WITH UNASSIGNED PLACEMENTS
scope: Indexes prior manuscript/source decisions. Not a new rules approval, access grant, retirement or source-deletion decision. Thirty structurally unassigned placements do not equal thirty wholly unreviewed mechanics.

placement.name: Resonance Shield
placement.summary: Spend RP to gain temporary HP: 5 temporary HP per RP spent.

original.name: Resonance Shield
original.effect: Spend any number of RP to gain 2 temporary HP per RP spent.

records.operationalDesignNotes: Conference decision: use the rank-0 1d4 effect plus mandatory1RP as the provisional single-ID rule. Retain all variants: rank0 catalog/Core1d4; rank2 catalog5tempHP perRP; rank2 Core2tempHP perRP. Rank2 alternatives are preserved as evidence, not cumulative effects or optional upgrades. Use Core30ft range and placement-specific focus requirement. Temporary HP end on next long rest; no fixed5 buff.
records.operationalLimitations: The additional 1 RP conversion cost is mandatory. Temporary HP never restore real HP and cannot generate resources when gained or lost. Recasting requires a new paid cast and roll; keep the higher remaining amount. Rank is class-specific, so this spell is not necessarily a cantrip for every class. If the Core source placement matching the class-specific school and rank includes F, an existing class casting focus is additionally required.

placement.name: Warding Bond
placement.summary: Link with ally; they gain +1 AC and saves, you take half their damage.

original.name: Warding Bond
original.effect: Link with ally; they gain +1 AC and saves, you take half their damage.

records.operationalDesignNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 30 feet, concentration 1 minute, +1 AC/saves and half-damage sharing; M/F uses focus. NEW: willing ally, conserved mandatory post-defense split, rounding, participation and life endpoints, no continued tether and ordinary-spell/class-engine separation. CONFLICT RULING: source-derived class access is rank 1; duplicate rank-2 block is retained as evidence only.
records.operationalLimitations: Use DAMAGE_SHARING_PLAYTEST.md: one transfer operation per original-recipient damage root, across all owners. A prior pre-mitigation split preempts this transfer; competing positive mandatory post-defense claims are chosen by the original target. The retained ally portion cannot subsequently be transferred again after this split. Complete the current packet's split and life consequences before concentration failure caused by that packet ends the bond; never undo a committed share. One Warding Bond per participating creature across all casters; casting cannot create chains or cycles. Initial range/line of effect are required, but no continuing distance or line-of-effect tether is imposed. This ordinary spell neither consumes nor increases the Paladin class redirection round ledger and grants none of its named healing/resource riders or proc permissions. Unrelated downstream triggers still require their own exact source authorization. Direct HP payments are not damage and cannot be transferred. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

placement.name: Arcane Lock
placement.summary: Magically secure a door or container.

original.name: Arcane Lock
original.effect: Magically secure a door or container.

records.operationalDesignNotes: Core V2 consistently gives Action, 30-foot range, V/S/F components, and an Instantaneous metadata duration, while the source requires an ongoing magical lock. An 8-hour duration, authorized-creature list, and force/tool check against Spell DC are NEW provisional mechanics. The three source rank placements remain preserved externally.
records.operationalLimitations: Does not make the object indestructible, repair it, increase its HP, prevent teleportation through unrelated magic, seal an open passage without a closable object, create a new physical lock, or protect against effects that explicitly dispel or bypass magical wards. One object cannot benefit from multiple Arcane Locks from the same caster. Source placements disagree on rank/RP; those are derived externally and not resolved here.

placement.name: Alignment Sanctuary
placement.summary: Area becomes sacred to an alignment; aligned creatures gain benefits.

original.name: Alignment Sanctuary
original.effect: Area becomes sacred to an alignment; aligned creatures gain benefits.

records.operationalDesignNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, Abjuration rank-3 opposed-entry Wisdom save and Shaman Conjuration rank-6 same-alignment safe haven. NEW CONFLICT RULINGS: fixed 10-foot-radius/height and concentration 1 minute replace Instantaneous metadata; actual modes stay separate, unassigned rank-6 Abjuration benefits remain blocked. NEW: snapshots, entry/teleport/Falling handling and exact two-axis Conjuration matching. Save-window/recast and rank-6 snapshot-validity completions are jointly reviewed provisional rules.
records.operationalLimitations: Both modes allow existing occupants to remain or leave; once outside, entry restrictions apply. Unsupported ordinary Falling is not arrested, supplies no platform and adds no movement; it can place a creature inside. No AC/save bonus, healing, rest guarantee, resource recovery, attack immunity, concealment, morality compulsion or alignment change. The ward denies entry rather than Actions and does not consume the shared hard-denial ledger. Multiple casters' wards retain independent source permissions and save windows; no single ward's success bypasses another ward. The preserved rank-6 Abjuration aligned-benefits placement has no actual class-access grant and stays unassigned/unavailable; its vague benefits are not imported. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.

placement.name: Mirror Image
placement.summary: Create three illusory duplicates of yourself.

original.name: Mirror Image
original.effect: Create three illusory duplicates of yourself.

records.operationalDesignNotes: The two Core V2 entries conflict: one gives 30-foot range and concentration up to 1 minute, while the other gives Self and Instantaneous. Because the source consistently says duplicates of yourself, this pilot uses self range and retains the coherent 1-minute concentration duration. V/S/M/F is represented as a small reflective token or existing class casting focus. Equal random selection and duplicate-hit procedure are NEW provisional mechanics.
records.operationalLimitations: Duplicates have no Actions, HP, independent positions, attacks, bodies, cover, collision, resource triggers, or ability to intercept saving-throw effects. They cannot be deliberately targeted by you or allies to generate procs. A creature that does not rely on sight or explicitly ignores visual illusions targets you normally. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
